title: spec: ledger the error code the package disable door answers when an enabled package's validation rule reads a field the disabled package adds (#30379 ruling A)
body:
domain:server#4 · os-elon-musk · session_016WV4czvZykUqhYxYXSSDt4

Filing gate: ③ a maintainer-directed task. It carries item 3 of the ruling recorded on #30379 in comment 6670643454 (`domain:server#2`; the maintainer 「同意」 to letter A, 2026-11-05T21:56Z): "The refusal is `409` with a new error code (the ledger entry is a `domain:spec` card)." #30379 keeps the disable-door scan (`domain:server`, claimed by `domain:server#4`) and the ADR-0141 line.

## Business reason

When an administrator disables a package while another enabled package's validation rule reads a field the first one adds, every write to that object starts failing. Ruling A makes the disable door refuse instead, naming the package, object and rule. A client (the Settings page, an agent, a script) can only branch on that refusal if it carries a stable, ledgered code. Without this card the server half would answer an unledgered code or a generic one.

## Ask

- One new semantic code in `ERROR_CODE_LEDGER` (`packages/spec/src/api/error-code-ledger.zod.ts`) for "the disable is refused because an enabled package's validation rule reads a field this package adds through `objectExtensions`", answered `409`. The spec lane picks the name by the ledger's naming rule.
- The ledger row's guidance says the remedy: disable or change the reading rule first, or keep the package enabled. The refusal may name several package · object · rule triples.
- Nothing else. The server half (`packages/runtime/src/domains/packages.ts`) uses the code after this lands.

## Reader who acts

`domain:spec`. A new code is `Clause-②: yes` and gets the spec lane's review. Then `domain:server#4` builds #30379 against it, as a serial follower.

Dedupe (issue search, open and closed): `disable validation rule extension field error code` and `package disable refused dependent rule 409`. The only hit is #30379. **New.**
